channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Israeli strikes devastate homes, displace families across Gaza
item.description: Israeli strikes hit several areas across Gaza, destroying homes in Khan Younis and sending thick smoke over Bureij camp.

item.title: Israeli strikes transform Lebanese city into ghost town
item.description: Nabatieh, once southern Lebanon’s economic centre, is now a ghost town as Israel intensifies attacks.

item.title: UK announces sanctions on West Bank settlements prompting furious Israeli response
item.description: Britain's foreign secretary accuses settlers of carrying out the "ethnic cleansing" of Palestinians, as Israel responds by shutting the UK consulate in East Jerusalem.

item.title: Ukrainian TV channel building hit by Russian drone as five killed in Kyiv
item.description: President Zelensky describes the daytime drone attack in Ukraine's capital as a "new page in Russian degradation"

item.title: Saudi Arabia vows to respond after Houthis attack cities and energy facilities
item.description: The Iran-backed Yemeni group's attacks have injured 73 people and caused fires at oil facilities, Saudi authorities say.

item.title: Five killed in Miami plane crash were in two vehicles on ground, investigators say
item.description: Investigators described the scene as "utter devastation" after a Boeing 767-300 overshot the runway at Miami airport.

item.title: In West Bank, date farmers weigh impact of UK sanctions on Israeli settlers
item.description: Palestinians strongly back a ban on settlement goods, but Israel's government says it is a "big mistake".

item.title: Where is Israel's proposed West Bank settlement the UK opposes?
item.description: BBC's Middle East correspondent Lucy Williamson reports from an area close to Israel's proposed site in the occupied West Bank.

item.title: Pupils return to West Bank school behind barbed wire to protect against settlers
item.description: Six people, including three pupils at the Palestinian school, have been killed in al-Mughayyir this year, in a surge of Israeli settler-related violence.

item.title: Five killed as Amazon cargo plane crashes at Miami airport
item.description: Video footage shows the aircraft burst into flames in Sunday's deadly incident.
